facts.fact: Levisionnaire reports on 2026-10-23 that Togo's personal data protection authority, the IPDCP, is running awareness work, including a session for over 250 young people on 2026-10-24 and a first national data protection day set for 2026-10-29.
The IPDCP is organising awareness sessions, a volunteer network of over 500 members and a regional panel for its first national data protection day on 2026-10-29, as reported on 2026-10-23.

TGO.note: Digital sovereignty is only the theme of an awareness day; no strategy, rule or hosting is stated.
